raw_sections.experience:
W O R K E X P E R I E N C E
Since Oct’24 | Lead Software Engineer | Randstad Digital | Client – Walmart Project: Identity Fraud Management Technologies: Java 17, Spring Boot, Docker, GraphQL, Spark, Airflow Microservices, Kafka Roles and Responsibilities:
Actively involved in design creation to drive technical solutions. • Managing a backend team of five engineers, ensuring effective collaboration and productivity.
Ensuring strict adherence to Agile methodologies and alignment with delivery timelines.
Build scalable and robust engineering solutions. • Focused on fostering high-performing, collaborative teams. •
Implemented features like quick reviews for that made integration with google AMP. Implemented data pipelines using Spark, Airflow DAG.
Oct’23-Oct’24 | Software Engineer-2 | Concentrix Catalyst | Client – T- Mobile Project: Identity Fraud Management Description: T-Mobile provided APIs to their vendors to securely access required user attribute information. Technologies: Java 11, Spring Boot, Spring Data, Docker, GraphQL, Oracle DB, Microservices, Kafka, RabbitMQ Roles and Responsibilities:
• •
Implemented GraphQL APIs to fetch required data for clients. Implemented RabbitMQ Messaging flow for Monetization mechanism. Implemented parent-pom mechanism for managing dependencies centrally.
Actively involved in design discussions, code reviews, bug fixing, and implementing unit and integration testing.
May’23-Oct’23 | Technical Specialist | Nokia Solutions Project: Automatic Switching of Network (ASON) Description: Nokia developed a web-based enterprise solution for 5G network vendors to manage the automatic routing process in case of optical fiber failures. Technologies: Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring Data, Docker, Elasticsearch, Oracle DB Roles and Responsibilities:
• Given demo of microservices architecture implementation and its benefits. Implemented excel report generation using Apache poi.
Implemented centralized logging system using ELK stack
May’21-May’23 | Software Engineer | Publicis Sapient| Client – City Bank Client: CITI Bank Project: Unified Reporting for Custody Reporting | Role: Software Developer
•
Description: Developed a stable web application for Citi Bank to streamline custody reporting. Contributed to building the landing page for report execution and scheduling. Technologies: Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring Data, AG-Grid, Micro-Service, Kafka, MongoDB, JSON, Mockito, OpenShift, React Roles and Responsibilities:
Extensively worked in designing/developing in web application for CITI Bank for managing custody reporting.
Designed and developed 4 microservices for report migration and
scheduling part of report. Implemented AG-Grid server-side Implementation of functionalities such as sorting, filtering, pagination. Implemented excel and csv report generation functionality using jasper report technology.
Given POC to client to reduce API response time by 100 times and implemented caching mechanism for storing entitlement information on server side. Involved in integration testing with front-end team, bug fixing session, support to QA team and given demo to client after every sprint. • To make fault tolerant code implement unit test cases using mockito
framework, done with rigorous local testing and integration testing as well.
Oct’18-May’21 | Software Engineer | Accenture Pvt. Ltd.| Client- Mela Elva Project: Pension and Insurance Web Application | Role: Software Developer Description: Client required stable web enterprise for their internal employees to manage the process of pension and insurance. We created a stable web application in which I have developed some new modules and added some functionalities to existing modules. Technologies: Core Java, Spring Boot, hibernate, JavaScript, Ajax, JSON Roles and Responsibilities:
Extensively worked in designing/developing in web application for Finish Client for their pension and insurance project. Implemented Spring batches for processing chunk of data. Involved in deployment activities.
